item.title: Three Tiny Islands Could Decide the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: At the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz sit three small rocky islands that most people have never heard of. item.title: Iran Strikes Two Oil Tankers Inside Iraqi Waters, Killing at Least One
item.description: Two oil tankers are burning in the Persian Gulf after an Iranian attack inside Iraqi territorial waters. At least one person is dead. item.description: During the Battle of Britain, RAF pilots discovered a flaw that their opponents were actively exploiting. item.title: Why BF 109s Always Ran Out Of Fuel
item.description: The Bf 109’s range problem during the Battle of Britain is one of the most discussed topics in WWII aviation.
